abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify field value is saved when valid input is provided
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify field value is saved when valid input is provided
Module: Issue Creation
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User has access to create or update an issue in the system.
- - The field (e.g., description or custom field) is available and visible on the issue creation or editing screen.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the issue creation page.
2. Enter valid text into the description field.
3. Enter a valid value into the customfield_10204 field.
4. Click the Save or Create button.
5. Open the newly created issue.
6. Verify the description and customfield_10204 fields display the values entered.

Expected Result:
- - The issue is successfully created.
- - The description and customfield_10204 field values are saved and visible in the issue details.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify system behavior when attempting to save an issue with a missing required field
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify system behavior when attempting to save an issue with a missing required field
Module: Issue Creation
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User has access to create or update an issue in the system.
- - The field (e.g., description or customfield_10204) is set as required in the system configuration.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the issue creation page.
2. Leave the required description or customfield_10204 field empty.
3. Fill in all other mandatory fields as needed.
4. Click the Save or Create button.

Expected Result:
- - The system displays an error message indicating the missing required field.
- - The issue is not saved.
- - The user remains on the issue creation page with validation feedback.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify maximum character limit for the description field
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify maximum character limit for the description field
Module: Issue Creation
Priority: Low

Preconditions:
- - User has access to create or update an issue in the system.
- - The maximum allowed character length for the description field is known (e.g., 255 characters).

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the issue creation page.
2. Enter a string into the description field that is exactly at the maximum allowed character length.
3. Click the Save or Create button.
4. Open the created issue.
5. Repeat the process with a string that exceeds the maximum character length by one character.

Expected Result:
- - When entering the maximum allowed number of characters, the issue is saved and the field value is displayed as entered.
- - When exceeding the maximum character limit, the system displays a validation error and does not save the issue.

abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_name: Verify Updating Issue Updates the "updated" Timestamp Successfully
abo_vm_test_case_manual.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Verify Updating Issue Updates the "updated" Timestamp Successfully
Module: Issue Management
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- - User is authenticated and has permission to update issues.
- - Issue SCRIP-100 exists in the system.

Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the issue SCRIP-100 detail page.
2. Edit any field such as "description" or "fix version".
3. Save the changes made to the issue.
4. Observe the "updated" timestamp displayed on the issue.

Expected Result:
- - Updated timestamp reflects the current date and time corresponding to the recent change.
- - The system confirms the changes were saved successfully.

Test Case Title: Location Search and Update Flow for Mumbai
Module: Location Search and Update
Priority: Medium

Preconditions:
- The application is installed and launched.
- User is on the start/main screen of the app.
- Device is connected to the internet.

Test Steps:
1. Wait until the “OK” button is visible on the screen.
2. Tap on the “OK” button.
3. Wait until the “Wind” text is visible.
4. Swipe down to refresh or show additional options.
5. Wait until the “Update” text view is visible.
6. Tap on the “Update” text view.
7. Tap on the “Search” button.
8. Wait until the “Search location” edit text field is visible.
9. Enter “Mumbai” in the search location edit field.
10. Wait until the “IN” option is visible in the search results.
11. Tap on the “IN” option.
12. Wait until the “Refresh” location button is visible.

Expected Result:
- “OK” button is displayed and can be tapped.
- Tapping “OK” navigates to a screen where “Wind” text is displayed.
- Swiping down reveals or refreshes the “Update” text view.
- “Update” text view is shown and is tappable.
- Tapping “Update” displays the “Search” button.
- “Search” button is present and can be tapped.
- Tapping “Search” shows a “Search location” edit text field.
- “Mumbai” can be typed into the search field.
- “IN” option appears in the search results when “Mumbai” is typed.
- “IN” option can be selected by tapping.
- “Refresh” location button becomes visible after the location is selected.
